propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific maintainer/bot DCO identity instead of the contributor's own configured git identity.
AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md prescribe signing off as Joe Oakhart's bot identity, contradicting CONTRIBUTING.md's requirement to use a real contributor name and email.
Guidance should instruct contributors and agents to sign off using git config user.name and git config user.email.
The bot identity should be retained only in narrowly scoped automation guidance that actually runs as that bot.
A deterministic make lint-integrated grep check should fail the build if the hardcoded personal sign-off is reintroduced in contributor-facing guidance.
Automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/) and experiment corpora (docs/experiments/) are intentionally excluded from the sweep and consistency check.
